name: beeswax + betaine + butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter + microcrystalline cellulose
purpose: Exfoliate, deeply cleanse pores and stimulate the skin's metabolism.
uses: 1. Apply to clean skin. 2. Gently massage a liberal amount of exfoliating scrub onto damp skin in circular motions. 3. Rinse thoroughly with water to reveal fresh and radiant skin.
otcwarn: For external use only. Keep out of reach of children.Avoid contact with eyes.
